Describe a compositional variable

Source: R/summary_compD.R
summary.compD.Rd

Describes a declare_composition() object by a per-part descriptive table and the compositional variation_matrix(). The table leads with the closed geometric mean of the imputed composition (the compositional centre, from geom_mean_comp()); its mean, SD, quartiles and range describe the original data, before zero imputation and closure. Printing the result shows a text report, as with summary.lm(), and pub_ready() builds a publication gt table from it.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'compD'
summary(object, desc = TRUE, var_matrix = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

object

A compD object from declare_composition().

desc

Logical; include the per-part descriptive table. Default TRUE.

var_matrix

Logical; include the variation matrix. Default TRUE.

...

Unused; present for S3 consistency.

Value

An object of class summary_compD, printed as a text report by print.summary_compD() and passed to pub_ready() for a gt table. A list with elements:

desc

One row per part: part, label (display label), then geom_mean (the closed geometric mean of the imputed composition), and mean, sd, median, p25, p75, min, max of the original data, before zero imputation and closure. NULL when desc = FALSE.

var_matrix

The variation matrix of the imputed composition, with leading part and label columns. NULL when var_matrix = FALSE.

parts, labels, closure, units

The part names, resolved display labels and closure of the compD, carried through for pub_ready(), and its unit label (NULL when none was declared), shown by print.summary_compD().

row_totals

A one-row tibble (mean, sd, min, max) of the raw part sums per observation, before imputation or closure. print.summary_compD() reports it to show how much row totals varied in the original data.

n_obs

The number of observations in the composition.

imput_table, impute_method

Carried through from the compD object (see declare_composition()), for print.summary_compD()'s zero-detection report.

outliers

A one-row tibble (n_outlier, pct, limit) summarizing the .outlier columns declare_composition() appended to data_raw, for print.summary_compD()'s outlier line. NULL when outliers were not flagged.

See also

declare_composition() to build the compD object; plot.compD() for the figures; pub_ready() for a formatted gt table built from this summary.

Other declare and describe composition: comp_impute(), comp_outliers(), declare_composition(), plot.compD()

Examples

cd <- declare_composition(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"),
                          closure = 1440)
s <- summary(cd)
s$desc
#> # A tibble: 4 × 10
#>   part  label geom_mean  mean    sd median   p25   p75   min   max
#>   <chr> <chr>     <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 MVPA  MVPA       28.1  45.9  44.7   35.0  12.7  61.8   0.1  240 
#> 2 LPA   LPA       235.  243.   86.9  232.  173.  308.   51.8  504.
#> 3 SB    SB        677.  661.  118.   669.  586.  743.  316.  1037.
#> 4 SPT   SPT       499.  491.  106.   489.  426.  559.  240.   815.
